design: Same H285 initialization, seeds, rates,strengths and update budget. Sum exact response loss statistics over all9 heads and both actual/angle payloads; normalize by summed baseline response error. Validation eligibility requires intactKL<=1.02 H280 and response error<=base for EACH of actual/angle x heads0:6/6:9. Lowest intactKL eligible, else same joint fallback using worst group. Zero-strength control declared. Head groups now both supervised.

gates.state_retention: all-head vs validation-selected zero-strength intact KL lower95 reduction>=-.02
gates.base_retention: response error vs base lower95 reduction>=-.02 in all4 groups
gates.specialist_retention: response error vs matching split specialist lower95 reduction>=-.02 in all4 groups
gates.response_gain: actual response error vs H280>=5% and lower95>0 in both groups

scope: Response regularizer uses output MSE, not downstream KL. Also report conditional response KL. Training-head exclusion applies only to this added response loss; base learned from all heads earlier. Not wholly unseen heads. No global optimum assertion.
